authors: Jill E. Hobbs, Jutta Roosen
official: 官方在线 2026-09-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We summarize the development of consumer economics and food demand in the Journal of Agricultural Economics over the past 100 years. Even from an early stage, the role of marketing agricultural products in a thriving agricultural sector was recognized within the works published in the Journal. Early papers focused on the demand for specific commodities and consumer trends more generally. Over time, analyses became more advanced, diving into the development of theory and methods for the estimation of demand systems. While this trend has continued, other topics have come to the forefront, such as consumer demand for food quality and safety, consumer acceptance of novel technologies, the demand for sustainable food products, and the role of nutrition and health in consumer studies. Methods were developed concurrently to address the new challenges that the agricultural sector faced, from secondary data analysis to primary data collection and experimental methods.
abstract_zh: 我们总结了《农业经济学杂志》过去100年中消费者经济学和食品需求的发展。即使在早期阶段，该杂志发表的作品就已认识到农产品营销在繁荣的农业部门中的作用。早期论文更侧重于特定商品的需求和更广泛的消费者趋势。随着时间的推移，分析变得更加先进，深入探讨了需求系统估计的理论和方法的发展。尽管这一趋势仍在延续，但其他主题已走到前沿，例如消费者对食品质量和安全的需求、消费者对新型技术的接受、对可持续食品的需求，以及营养和健康在消费者研究中的作用。与此同时，方法也得到了发展，以应对农业部门面临的新挑战，从二手数据分析到原始数据收集和实验方法。

authors: Mathias Drehmann, Xuewen Fu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Focus How far can central banks shrink their balance sheets? The answer depends on the demand for central bank reserves and in particular on whether the drivers widely believed to have raised it over the past decade actually do. These drivers are: (i) post-Great Financial Crisis (GFC) liquidity regulation; (ii) the difficulty of monetising government bonds into reserves during stress; and (iii) the atrophy of interbank markets after years of abundant reserves. We ask whether these drivers really do shift reserve demand and what this implies for balance sheet normalisation.
abstract_zh: 焦点 中央银行能将资产负债表缩减到何种程度？答案取决于对央行准备金的需求，尤其是过去十年中被广泛认为推高这一需求的因素是否确实如此。这些因素包括：（一）后金融危机时期的流动性监管；（二）在压力时期将政府债券变现为准备金的难度；（三）多年准备金充裕后银行间市场的萎缩。我们探究这些因素是否真正改变了准备金需求，以及这对资产负债表正常化意味着什么。

title: Assessing the Environmental, Economic and Social Impacts of a Greenhouse Gas Emission Tax in Swiss Agriculture
title_zh: 评估瑞士农业温室气体排放税的环境、经济与社会影响
title_primary: 评估瑞士农业温室气体排放税的环境、经济与社会影响
title_secondary: Assessing the Environmental, Economic and Social Impacts of a Greenhouse Gas Emission Tax in Swiss Agriculture
authors: Marta Tarruella‐Cayuela, Nadja El Benni, Eva Winter, Robert Huber, Robert Finger 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Agriculture accounts for about one fifth of global greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, making mitigation a key policy priority. Although policymakers are increasingly considering market‐based approaches such as taxes, their broader impacts remain insufficiently assessed. This study examines the environmental, economic and social impacts of a GHG tax on Swiss agriculture. Using the agent‐based sector model SWISSland, representing 3077 farms and capturing heterogeneous responses to taxation and structural change, we simulate tax levels of 100, 200 and 300 CHF/tCO 2 eq for 2024–2030. We consider three mitigation pathways: technical measures, structural changes in land use and livestock numbers, and farm exits. We assess their impacts on GHG emissions, nitrogen surpluses, biodiversity, farm income, food production and food security. A GHG tax activates abatement mechanisms and induces dairy herd reductions, grassland extensification, shifts towards crop production for direct human consumption, and livestock farm exits. At 100 and 200 CHF/tCO 2 eq, emission reductions are mainly driven by technical measures, whereas at 300 CHF/tCO 2 eq they increasingly result from structural adjustment, including livestock farm exits and land reallocation to less emissions‐intensive production. A tax of 100 CHF/tCO 2 eq reduces emissions by 5%, while higher tax rates achieve greater reductions but increase sectoral income losses from 13% to 25%. Food self‐sufficiency and calorie production remain stable. The model also shows environmental co‐benefits, including lower nitrogen surpluses and increased biodiversity areas. These findings highlight synergies and trade‐offs across sustainability dimensions and suggest that redistributing tax revenues could mitigate adverse effects and improve policy outcomes, while enhancing the policy's social acceptability.
abstract_zh: 农业约占全球温室气体排放的五分之一，因此减缓排放成为关键的政策优先事项。尽管政策制定者日益考虑基于市场的手段（如税收），但其更广泛的影响仍未得到充分评估。本研究考察了温室气体税对瑞士农业的环境、经济和社会影响。利用基于主体的部门模型SWISSland，该模型代表了3077个农场，并捕捉了对税收和结构变化的异质性反应，我们模拟了2024—2030年间100、200和300瑞士法郎/吨二氧化碳当量的税率水平。我们考虑了三种减缓路径：技术措施、土地利用和牲畜数量的结构变化以及农场退出。我们评估了这些路径对温室气体排放、氮盈余、生物多样性、农场收入、粮食生产和粮食安全的影响。温室气体税激活了减排机制，并导致奶牛群减少、草地粗放化、转向直接供人类消费的作物生产以及畜牧农场的退出。在100和200瑞士法郎/吨二氧化碳当量时，减排主要由技术措施驱动，而在300瑞士法郎/吨二氧化碳当量时，减排越来越多地源于结构调整，包括畜牧农场退出和土地重新配置到排放强度较低的生产。100瑞士法郎/吨二氧化碳当量的税收可使排放减少5%，而更高的税率实现更大的减排，但部门收入损失从13%增加到25%。粮食自给率和热量生产保持稳定。模型还显示了环境协同效益，包括氮盈余降低和生物多样性面积增加。这些发现凸显了各可持续性维度之间的协同效应和权衡，并表明重新分配税收收入可以减轻不利影响、改善政策结果，同时提高政策的社会可接受性。

title: Building infrastructure and cohesion through locally embedded institutions: Evidence from a field experiment in War-torn Eastern Congo
title_zh: 通过地方嵌入制度构建基础设施与社会凝聚力：来自战乱刚果东部实地实验的证据
title_primary: 通过地方嵌入制度构建基础设施与社会凝聚力：来自战乱刚果东部实地实验的证据
title_secondary: Building infrastructure and cohesion through locally embedded institutions: Evidence from a field experiment in War-torn Eastern Congo
authors: Eric Mvukiyehe, Julie Bousquet, Marijke Verpoorten
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A defining feature of many Community-Driven Development (CDD) interventions in wartorn countries is their pursuit of transformative objectives, seeking to (re)shape local decisionmaking institutions in the process. In recent years, there has been a push to overhaul CDD approaches, with a focus on more realistic objectives aimed at providing infrastructure and building capacity of existing local institutions. We investigate, through a large-scale field experiment involving 400 communities in eastern Congo, the effects of a CDD program that embodied this new focus. Our strategy allows us to identify causal impacts of the CDD intervention, in its basic form consisting of a US$100,000 envelope to finance an infrastructure project with an emphasis on ‘local content’, as well as when augmented with a complementary conflict mitigation component. While the intervention successfully delivered visible infrastructure projects, we find no detectable effects on social cohesion, (violent) conflict, or economic welfare. We conclude discussing policy implications.
abstract_zh: 许多饱受战争蹂躏国家中的社区驱动发展（CDD）干预措施的一个显著特征在于其追求变革性目标，旨在过程中（重新）塑造地方决策机构。近年来，推动了对CDD方法的改革，重点转向更为现实的目标，即提供基础设施并增强现有地方机构的能力。我们通过一项涉及刚果东部400个社区的大规模实地实验，考察了体现这一新重点的CDD项目的影响。我们的研究策略使我们能够识别CDD干预的因果效应，其基本形式包括一笔10万美元的资金用于资助一个强调“本地内容”的基础设施项目，以及当辅以一项补充性冲突缓解组成部分时的效果。尽管干预成功交付了可见的基础设施项目，但我们未发现对社会凝聚力、（暴力）冲突或经济福利有可检测的影响。最后，我们讨论了政策启示。

title: Administrative litigation and public procurement outcomes: Evidence from Italy
title_zh: 行政诉讼与公共采购结果：来自意大利的证据
title_primary: 行政诉讼与公共采购结果：来自意大利的证据
title_secondary: Administrative litigation and public procurement outcomes: Evidence from Italy
authors: Enza Maltese, Gabriele Rovigatti
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Administrative review protects legality and contestability in public procurement, but it may also delay public investment, alter the choices of contracting authorities and generate defensive responses by public administrations. This paper studies these effects by linking the universe of Italian procurement procedures to newly released administrative-court records for 2023–2025. Appeals concern only 0.4 percent of procedures but 7.2 percent of tendered value and are concentrated in large, competitive contracts. Using matched duration models, we show that litigated procedures are associated with award times more than 35 percent longer than comparable procedures without appeals and that public works also reach construction-site opening later. Being subject to an appeal has sizeable effects on the subsequent behavior of contracting authorities, as they publish fewer (-30 percent) and smaller (-55 percent on average) public-works tenders and shift away from open procedures toward direct awards. These changes are larger among municipalities with lower administrative capacity. The evidence points to an enforcement-capacity trade-off: administrative review safeguards procurement integrity, but its administrative burden can slow implementation and induce defensive behavior where state capacity is weak.
abstract_zh: 行政诉讼审查保障了公共采购中的合法性与可争议性，但同时也可能延迟公共投资、改变采购机关的选择，并引发公共行政部门的防御性反应。本文通过将意大利采购程序的总体数据与2023至2025年间新发布的行政法院记录相链接，研究了这些效应。上诉仅涉及0.4%的程序，但占招标价值的7.2%，且集中于大型、竞争性合同中。利用匹配持续时间模型，我们表明，涉诉程序的中标时间比无上诉的可比程序长超过35%，且公共工程到达施工场地开工的时间也更晚。受到上诉影响对采购机关后续行为产生显著效应，它们发布的公共工程招标数量减少（-30%），规模缩小（平均-55%），并从公开招标程序转向直接授予。这些变化在行政能力较低的市政当局中更为显著。证据指向一种执行能力权衡：行政诉讼审查保障了采购的完整性，但其行政负担可能减缓实施进度，并在国家能力薄弱之处诱发防御性行为。

title: Humans in the Loop: The Next Frontier in the Credibility Revolution
title_zh: 人类在循环中：可信度革命的下一个前沿
title_primary: 人类在循环中：可信度革命的下一个前沿
title_secondary: Humans in the Loop: The Next Frontier in the Credibility Revolution
authors: Stevenson, Megan T., Fischman, Joshua B.
official: 来源期次 2026-09-01 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Something is amiss in empirical economics. Despite the advances of the credibility revolution, published estimates tend to be inflated and overconfident. We argue that this stems from a weakness in the dominant econometric framework: treating the researcher like a calculator that mechanically implements the econometric method. We use several examples to show how properties of estimators change dramatically with humans in the loop. Under plausible assumptions on researcher behavior, low-power estimators such as instrumental variables exhibit high degrees of bias, even with a first-stage F-statistic of 200. Threshold testing on the first-stage F-statistic can reduce bias, contrary to Angrist and Kolesár (2024). And standard errors understate uncertainty, since they ignore variation due to researchers’ subjective choices. Ignoring the role of humans “in the research loop” can lead to highly biased and unreliable findings. Modifying econometric practices to address the human factor is a critical frontier of the credibility revolution. (JEL C12, C13, C26)
abstract_zh: 实证经济学中存在某种偏差。尽管可信性革命取得了进展，但已发表的估计结果往往存在膨胀和过度自信的问题。我们认为，这源于主流计量经济学框架的一个缺陷：将研究者视为机械执行计量方法的计算器。我们通过多个案例展示了当人类介入研究过程时，估计量的性质会发生显著变化。在关于研究者行为的合理假设下，即使第一阶段F统计量达到200，工具变量等低功效估计量仍会表现出高度偏误。与Angrist和Kolesár（2024）的结论相反，对第一阶段F统计量进行阈值检验可以降低偏误。而标准误低估了不确定性，因为它忽略了研究者主观选择带来的变异。忽视"研究循环"中人类角色的作用，可能导致高度偏误且不可靠的研究结论。调整计量实践以应对人为因素，是可信性革命的关键前沿。

title: The China Backlash: Quantifying the Narrative Discourse on China
title_zh: 中国反弹：量化关于中国的叙事话语
title_primary: 中国反弹：量化关于中国的叙事话语
title_secondary: The China Backlash: Quantifying the Narrative Discourse on China
authors: Dani Rodrik, Mert Geyiktepe
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using text-as-data methods, we quantify the U.S. discourse on China, place it in historical perspective, and compare its evolution across different sources of public narrative. Our analysis is based on a large corpus of materials drawn from public records (presidential and congressional records, newspaper articles, social media, think tank reports). We develop two measures of narrative discourse: an indicator of the frequency with which China is covered and a proxy for how positively or negatively China is presented. We document a sustained decline in net sentiment towards China in presidential sources since the early 2000s, predating Donald Trump’s first term in office. In contrast to presidential documents, congressional, news media, social media, and think tank sources exhibit persistent negative sentiment towards China even in decades prior to the 2000s. Instead of a deterioration in sentiment across the board, what we find is a convergence in presidential sentiment to other sources of narrative discourse. We find no evidence that presidential leadership has played a significant role in setting the narrative tone for the nation as a whole. Historical and shorter-term evidence both point to a bottom-up process of diffusion of narratives, rather than top-down diffusion.
abstract_zh: 采用文本数据方法，我们量化了美国涉华话语体系，将其置于历史视角下审视，并比较了不同公共叙事来源的演变过程。分析基于涵盖公共记录（总统与国会档案、报刊文章、社交媒体、智库报告）的大型语料库。我们构建了叙事话语的两项指标：中国话题的报道频率指数，以及中国形象呈现的正面/负面倾向代理变量。研究发现，自21世纪初以来，总统文献中对华净情感指数持续走低，这一趋势早于唐纳德·特朗普的首个任期。与总统文献形成对比的是，国会、新闻媒体、社交媒体及智库来源在21世纪前的数十年间已持续呈现对华负面倾向。我们观察到的并非全面情感恶化，而是总统话语与其他叙事来源的趋同现象。未发现总统领导力在塑造全国叙事基调中发挥显著作用的证据。历史与短期证据均指向叙事传播的自下而上模式，而非自上而下扩散。

title: Achieving a European Banking Union without increasing risks
title_zh: 在不增加风险的前提下实现欧洲银行业联盟

authors: Gyöngyi Lóránth, Anatoli Segura, Jing Zeng
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: European banking remains fragmented, leaving billions of euros inefficiently allocated. Reforms to establish a European deposit insurance system have been proposed to allow cross-border banking groups to operate more freely. This column argues that a common deposit insurance system fundamentally changes the link between risk-sharing and risk-taking. In addition to greater integration, it can encourage more risk-taking, with unclear effects on overall welfare. Therefore, greater freedom to move capital and liquidity across borders should be accompanied by sufficiently strict supervision to address the risk-taking incentives created by such reforms.
abstract_zh: 欧洲银行业仍处于碎片化状态，导致数十亿欧元资金配置效率低下。为建立欧洲存款保险体系而提出的改革方案，旨在允许跨境银行集团更自由地运营。本专栏认为，共同存款保险体系从根本上改变了风险分担与风险承担之间的关联。除了促进一体化外，它还可能鼓励更多风险承担行为，但对整体福利的影响尚不明确。因此，在赋予资本和流动性跨境流动更大自由度的同时，必须辅以足够严格的监管，以应对此类改革所催生的风险承担激励。

title: Innovation through Inventor Mobility: Evidence from Non-Compete Agreements
title_zh: 发明人流动性与创新：基于竞业禁止协议的证据
title_primary: 发明人流动性与创新：基于竞业禁止协议的证据
title_secondary: Innovation through Inventor Mobility: Evidence from Non-Compete Agreements
authors: Reinmuth, Kate, Rockall, Emma
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Proponents of labor mobility restrictions argue that innovation incentives more than offset harm to workers. Yet the causal effect of such policies on innovation is an open empirical question. Leveraging plausibly exogenous state-level changes in the enforceability of noncompete agreements, we find a significant negative effect on innovation. This effect is even larger for the most novel and innovative patents and firms. Further analysis shows that these negative effects on innovation cannot be explained by entry alone and instead likely result from reduced knowledge flows. Our findings suggest that labor mobility plays a crucial role in spreading knowledge across firms.
abstract_zh: 劳动力流动限制的支持者认为，创新激励足以抵消对工人的损害。然而，此类政策对创新的因果效应仍是一个悬而未决的实证问题。利用各州竞业禁止协议可执行性看似外生的变化，我们发现其对创新产生了显著的负面影响。对于最具新颖性和创新性的专利及企业而言，这种负面效应甚至更大。进一步分析表明，这些对创新的负面影响无法仅用市场进入来解释，而更可能源于知识流动的减少。我们的研究结果表明，劳动力流动在跨企业知识传播中发挥着关键作用。

authors: Mondher Bouattour, Amine Ben Amar, E. Galariotis, N. Hachicha
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This letter examines the impact of the 2026 Iran conflict and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz on Middle Eastern Stock Markets. The findings reveal heterogeneous effects across the region, with the largest market responses concentrated in Qatar, the UAE, and Egypt. Sectoral analysis further reveals varied gradual adjustment dynamics across industries, with the real estate, healthcare, consumer discretionary, consumer staples and financial sectors exhibiting the largest declines. These results highlight the rapid transmission of geopolitical risk across regional financial markets and underscore the vulnerability of Gulf economies to disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2026年伊朗冲突及霍尔木兹海峡关闭对中东股市的影响。研究发现，该地区市场反应存在异质性，其中卡塔尔、阿联酋和埃及的市场响应最为显著。行业层面的分析进一步揭示了各行业间不同的渐进调整动态，房地产、医疗保健、非必需消费品、必需消费品及金融板块跌幅最大。这些结果凸显了地缘政治风险在区域金融市场中的快速传导，并强调了海湾经济体对霍尔木兹海峡中断的脆弱性。

title: The Long-Run Effects of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 货币政策的长期效应
title_primary: 货币政策的长期效应
title_secondary: The Long-Run Effects of Monetary Policy
authors: Òscar Jordà, Sanjay R. Singh, Alan M. Taylor
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We document that the real effects of monetary shocks last for over a decade. Our approach relies on identification of exogenous and nonsystematic monetary shocks using the trilemma of international finance; merged data from two new international historical cross-country databases; and econometric methods robust to long-horizon inconsistent estimates. Notably, the capital stock and total factor productivity exhibit greater hysteresis than labor. When we allow for asymmetry, we find these effects with tightening shocks but not with loosening shocks. When extending the horizon of the responses reported in several recent studies that use alternative monetary shocks, we find similarly persistent real effects, thus supporting our main findings.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，货币冲击的实际效应持续超过十年。我们的研究方法依赖于利用国际金融三难困境识别外生且非系统性的货币冲击；整合自两个新型国际历史跨国数据库的合并数据；以及能够应对长期估计不一致性的计量经济学方法。值得注意的是，资本存量与全要素生产率比劳动力表现出更强的滞后效应。在考虑非对称性时，我们发现紧缩性冲击会产生这些效应，而宽松性冲击则不会。当将近期多项采用替代性货币冲击的研究所报告的反应期限延长后，我们同样观察到持续的实际效应，从而佐证了我们的核心发现。

title: Healthcare access and human capital: evidence from Medicaid expansion
title_zh: 医疗可及性与人力资本：来自医疗补助扩展的证据
title_primary: 医疗可及性与人力资本：来自医疗补助扩展的证据
title_secondary: Healthcare access and human capital: evidence from Medicaid expansion
authors: Annabel Qiu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates whether healthcare access affects educational achievement, exploiting the staggered ACA Medicaid expansion. Using county-level panel data on ACT scores, insurance coverage, and health indicators for 2012–2024, I find that Medicaid expansion raised county-level ACT composite scores by 0.50 to 0.85 points (about 0.22 standard deviations in the controlled specification). A Callaway and Sant’anna heterogeneity-robust estimator yields a simple aggregated ATT of 0.79, indicating the result is not an artefact of forbidden comparisons, and an event study is consistent with parallel pre-trends, with effects building to approximately 1.3 points by 6 years that I read as a suggestive long-run trajectory. The estimate attenuates and loses significance under within-region and within-division comparison and under relative-magnitude pre-trend violations, so I interpret it as suggestive of a causal effect under the design’s identifying assumptions rather than a firmly established magnitude. A supplementary instrumental-variables specification is consistent in sign but imprecise. A selection test does not detect changes in test participation, and channel analysis finds that observable health and economic indicators do not meaningfully mediate the effect, leaving the mechanism an open question for future research with individual-level data.
abstract_zh: 本文利用《平价医疗法案》下各州分阶段实施的医疗补助扩展政策，探究医疗可及性是否影响教育成就。基于2012–2024年县级面板数据（涵盖ACT成绩、保险覆盖率及健康指标），研究发现医疗补助扩展使县级ACT综合成绩提升0.50至0.85分（在控制规范中约为0.22个标准差）。采用Callaway与Sant'anna提出的异质性稳健估计量，得到简单汇总的平均处理效应（ATT）为0.79，表明该结果并非由禁止性比较造成的人为现象；事件研究支持平行趋势假设，且效应在6年内累积至约1.3分，可视为长期趋势的提示性证据。在区域内部及分区内部比较中，以及相对幅度事前趋势违反条件下，估计值减弱并失去显著性，因此本文将其解读为在设计识别假设下具有因果效应的提示性证据，而非确凿的效应量级。辅助工具变量估计在符号上一致但精度不足。选择检验未发现考试参与率变化，渠道分析表明可观测的健康与经济指标并未显著中介该效应，其作用机制有待未来基于个体层面数据的研究进一步探索。

title: Global Working Hours
title_zh: 全球工时
title_primary: 全球工时
title_secondary: Global Working Hours
authors: Amory Gethin, Emmanuel Saez
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article uses labor force surveys from 160 countries to build a new microdatabase on hours worked covering 97% of the world population in cross section. We also construct time series spanning over 20 years in 86 countries. Hours worked per adult slightly decline with GDP per capita but are weakly correlated with development overall. Hours worked by the young (aged 15–19) and elderly (aged 60+) fall with development, driven entirely by growing school attendance and public pension coverage. Hours worked among prime-age adults (aged 20–59) are stable with development but undergo a great gender reshuffling: falling hours per male worker have been exactly offset by increases in female labor force participation in many countries. Labor income taxes are strongly negatively related to hours worked across countries. This correlation is attenuated when controlling for social spending and disappears when further controlling for working hours regulations. Both social spending and working hours regulations are associated with lower hours worked.
abstract_zh: 本文利用来自160个国家的劳动力调查，构建了一个覆盖全球97%人口的工时微观数据库（横截面数据）。同时，我们建立了涵盖86个国家、跨度超过20年的时间序列数据。成年人平均工时随人均GDP增长略有下降，但总体而言与经济发展水平的相关性较弱。青少年（15-19岁）和老年人（60岁以上）的工时随经济发展而减少，这完全是由入学率和公共养老金覆盖率的提高所驱动的。壮年劳动力（20-59岁）的工时随经济发展保持稳定，但经历了显著的性别结构重组：在许多国家，男性工人工时的下降恰好被女性劳动参与率的上升所抵消。劳动所得税与各国工时呈显著负相关。当控制社会支出后，这一相关性减弱；进一步控制工时法规后，该相关性消失。社会支出和工时法规均与较低的工时水平相关。

title: Online Benefit Redemption and SNAP Participation: Evidence From the SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot
title_zh: 在线福利兑换与SNAP参与：来自SNAP在线购买试点的证据
title_primary: 在线福利兑换与SNAP参与：来自SNAP在线购买试点的证据
title_secondary: Online Benefit Redemption and SNAP Participation: Evidence From the SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot
authors: Chaebeen Yoon, Xiaowei Zhang, Qingxiao Li
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) is the largest federal nutrition assistance program in the United States, yet many eligible households do not participate due to administrative burdens, stigma, and geographic access constraints. We examine whether the SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot (OPP), which allows beneficiaries to redeem benefits online, affects program participation. Using a difference‐in‐differences design with state‐level data from 2017 to 2021, we find that SNAP OPP increases program participation per capita by 13.7% (1.6 percentage points) and participation among individuals below the poverty line by 11.3% (11 percentage points). Event‐study estimates indicate effects emerge within three months and persist thereafter. Participation gains are larger in states with higher digital infrastructure (computer ownership and internet access) and greater vehicle access, indicating that online and physical access function as complements. States with higher shares of elderly residents and households with children also exhibit stronger responses. These findings suggest that enabling online benefit redemption can expand safety net access, though benefits vary systematically with local infrastructure and demographic composition.
abstract_zh: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）是美国最大的联邦营养援助项目，但由于行政负担、污名化以及地理可达性限制，许多符合条件的家庭并未参与其中。我们考察了SNAP在线购买试点项目（OPP）——该试点允许受益人通过在线方式兑换福利——是否会影响项目参与率。利用2017年至2021年的州级数据，采用双重差分法进行分析，我们发现SNAP OPP使人均项目参与率提高了13.7%（1.6个百分点），贫困线以下个体的参与率提高了11.3%（11个百分点）。事件研究估计表明，该效应在三个月内显现并持续存在。在数字基础设施（计算机拥有率和互联网接入率）更完善以及车辆可及性更高的州，参与率增幅更大，这表明在线与实体可达性具有互补作用。老年居民比例较高以及有儿童家庭比例较高的州也表现出更强的响应。这些发现表明，允许在线福利兑换能够扩大安全网的可及性，但其效益会因当地基础设施和人口结构的差异而呈现系统性变化。

title: International reserves and firm investment: Identification through bank credit reallocation
title_zh: 国际储备与企业投资：基于银行信贷再配置的识别
title_primary: 国际储备与企业投资：基于银行信贷再配置的识别
title_secondary: International reserves and firm investment: Identification through bank credit reallocation
authors: Woo Jin Choi, Ju Hyun Pyun, Youngjin Yun
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A central bank’s accumulation of foreign reserves can reallocate domestic credit and influence investments among firms. Exploiting institutional features in Korea and connecting firms with their lending banks from 2004 to 2019, we examine how reserve accumulation and sterilization affect credit allocation and firm investment. We track the issuance of sterilization bonds by the central bank to finance reserve purchases and identify heterogeneous exposure across banks. Banks more responsive to sterilization absorb larger quantities of these bonds and adjust their loans accordingly. We find that firms–particularly those with higher liabilities to such banks–reduce investment during periods of reserve accumulation. The impact of reserve-induced credit reallocation on firm investment is centered primarily on non-listed firms, non-exporters, and firms with low productivity.
abstract_zh: 中央银行积累外汇储备能够重新配置国内信贷，并影响企业间的投资。利用韩国的制度特征，并将2004年至2019年间企业与贷款银行相匹配，我们考察了储备积累及冲销操作如何影响信贷配置与企业投资。我们追踪了中央银行为融资储备购买而发行的冲销债券，并识别了不同银行间暴露程度的异质性。对冲销操作反应更积极的银行吸收了更大数量的这些债券，并相应调整了其贷款。我们发现，在储备积累期间，企业——尤其是对那些银行负债较高的企业——减少了投资。储备引致的信贷重新配置对企业投资的影响主要集中在非上市企业、非出口企业以及生产率较低的企业。

title: Racial Disparities in Federal Sentencing: Evidence from Drug Mandatory Minimums
title_zh: 联邦量刑中的种族差异：来自毒品强制最低刑期的证据
title_primary: 联邦量刑中的种族差异：来自毒品强制最低刑期的证据
title_secondary: Racial Disparities in Federal Sentencing: Evidence from Drug Mandatory Minimums
authors: Cody Tuttle
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I study racial disparities in the criminal justice system by analysing abnormal bunching in the distribution of crack-cocaine amounts used in federal sentencing. I compare cases sentenced before and after the Fair Sentencing Act, a 2010 law that changed the 10-year mandatory minimum threshold for crack-cocaine from 50 g to 280 g. First, I find that after 2010, there is a sharp increase in the fraction of cases sentenced at 280 g (the point that now triggers a 10-year mandatory minimum), and that this increase is disproportionately large for black and Hispanic offenders. I then explore several possible explanations for the observed racial disparities, including racial discrimination that occurs after entry into the criminal justice system. I analyse data from multiple stages in the criminal justice system and find that the increased bunching for minority offenders is driven by prosecutorial discretion, specifically as used by about 20–30% of prosecutors. Moreover, the fraction of cases at 280 g falls in 2013 when evidentiary standards become stricter. Finally, the racial disparity in the increase cannot be explained by differences in education, sex, age, criminal history, seized drug amount, or other elements of the crime, but it can be largely explained by a measure of state-level racial animus. These results shed light on the role of prosecutorial discretion and racial discrimination as causes of racial disparities in sentencing.
abstract_zh: 本文通过分析联邦量刑中快克可卡因数量分布的异常聚集现象，研究刑事司法体系中的种族差异。我将2010年《公平量刑法》实施前后判决的案件进行对比——该法案将触发10年强制最低刑期的快克可卡因门槛从50克调整为280克。首先发现，2010年后以280克（当前触发10年强制最低刑期的临界点）量刑的案件比例急剧上升，且黑人及西班牙裔罪犯在此增幅中占比显著偏高。随后探讨了导致观察到的种族差异的几种可能解释，包括进入刑事司法体系后发生的种族歧视。通过分析刑事司法体系多个阶段的数据，发现少数族裔罪犯的聚集现象加剧源于检察官的自由裁量权，具体表现为约20-30%检察官的裁量行为。此外，当2013年证据标准趋严时，280克量刑案件比例出现下降。最后，这种增幅中的种族差异无法通过教育程度、性别、年龄、犯罪前科、毒品查获数量或其他犯罪要素来解释，但可在很大程度上由州级种族敌意指标解释。这些研究结果揭示了检察官自由裁量权与种族歧视作为量刑种族差异成因的作用机制。

title: Gendered Capability Deprivation in Early Childhood: Evidence from Four MENA Countries
title_zh: 早期儿童性别能力剥夺：来自四个中东和北非国家的证据
title_primary: 早期儿童性别能力剥夺：来自四个中东和北非国家的证据
title_secondary: Gendered Capability Deprivation in Early Childhood: Evidence from Four MENA Countries
authors: Abu-Zaineh, Mohammad, Yousef, Sahar F.
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This article examines gender differences in early childhood capability deprivation in Algeria, Morocco, Syria, and Yemen. Using nationally representative surveys from the Pan Arab Project for Family Health, we estimate deprivation among children aged 0-4 in three latent dimensions: nutrition, sanitation, and access to information. The empirical strategy combines a capability-deprivation framework with multi-group structural equation modelling, measurement-invariance tests, and multidimensional aggregation. The results show that gendered deprivation is neither uniform nor always to the disadvantage of girls. Female children are more likely to be capability deprived on aggregate in Algeria, Morocco, and Yemen, while male children appear more deprived in Syria. Gender disparities also vary across dimensions: boys are more likely to be nutrition-deprived in Morocco and Syria, while girls are more likely to be sanitation-deprived in Algeria and Morocco and information-deprived in Morocco and Yemen. Rural residence and low household-head education are generally associated with weaker achievements in nutrition, sanitation, and information. The findings contribute to applied research on child poverty measurement and gender inequality by showing that gendered capability deprivation is observable before school age and is patterned by household and public-service conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了阿尔及利亚、摩洛哥、叙利亚和也门四国儿童早期能力剥夺的性别差异。基于泛阿拉伯家庭健康项目的全国代表性调查数据，我们估算了0-4岁儿童在营养、卫生设施和信息获取三个潜在维度上的剥夺状况。实证策略将能力剥夺框架与多组结构方程模型、测量不变性检验及多维聚合方法相结合。研究结果表明：性别化的剥夺既非均匀分布，也并非总是不利于女童。在阿尔及利亚、摩洛哥和也门，女童在综合指标上更易遭受能力剥夺，而叙利亚男童的剥夺程度则更为显著。性别差异在不同维度上呈现异质性：摩洛哥和叙利亚男童更易出现营养剥夺，阿尔及利亚和摩洛哥女童更易面临卫生设施剥夺，摩洛哥和也门女童则在信息获取方面处于劣势。农村居住环境与户主低教育水平通常与营养、卫生设施及信息获取方面的弱势表现相关。本研究通过揭示学龄前阶段已存在性别化的能力剥夺现象，且该现象受家庭与公共服务条件影响，为儿童贫困测量与性别不平等领域的应用研究提供了新证据。

title_zh: 使用消费者食品数据系统数据集衡量营养安全
title_primary: 使用消费者食品数据系统数据集衡量营养安全
title_secondary: Measuring Nutrition Security Using the Consumer Food Data System Datasets
authors: Vibha Bhargava, Jung Sun Lee, Travis A. Smith
official: 官方在线 2026-04-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Nutrition security is an emerging concept lacking a consensus definition, conceptualization, or standardized measure. This perspectives manuscript synthesizes findings from two previously published analyses to assess the feasibility of using available measures of key dimensions of nutrition security from two Consumer Food Data System (CFDS) datasets: the 2012–2013 National Household Food Acquisition and Purchase Survey (FoodAPS) and the 2007–2018 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey/Flexible Consumer Behavior Survey (NHANES/FCBS), in deriving a measure of nutrition security aligned with the U. S. Department of Agriculture's definition. This study highlights methodological considerations, strengths and limitations of the two datasets for developing nutrition security metrics, and informs future research on standardized measurement for national nutrition monitoring.
abstract_zh: 摘要 营养安全是一个新兴概念，目前缺乏共识性的定义、概念化或标准化衡量方法。本观点性文章综合了两项先前发表的分析结果，评估利用消费者食品数据系统（CFDS）两个数据集中的关键营养安全维度可用指标来推导与农业部定义相符的营养安全衡量指标的可行性，这两个数据集分别是2012-2013年全国家庭食品获取与购买调查（FoodAPS）和2007-2018年全国健康与营养检查调查/灵活消费者行为调查（NHANES/FCBS）。本研究强调了在开发营养安全指标时的方法学考量、两个数据集的优势与局限性，并为未来国家营养监测标准化测量的研究提供参考。

authors: 张征宇, 陈浩文, 邵黎娜, 曹思力, 朱平芳

abstract: 共同富裕是中国式现代化的重要特征，如何在促进经济增长的同时改善低收入群体福利，成为当前政策关注的核心议题之一。本文聚焦新型基础设施建设的共同富裕效应，提出以尾部平均处理效应为核心的政策评估框架，用于直接衡量政策对收入分布尾端个体的影响，从而在统一框架下同时检验政策的增长效应与再分配效应，并给出其潜在的政策优化路径。结果显示，新型基础设施建设不仅显著提升了整体居民收入，而且对低收入群体的增收作用更为...

title: Causal evidence of antitrust damages in the car manufacturers’ cartel in Spain
title_zh: 西班牙汽车制造商卡特尔反垄断损害赔偿的因果证据
title_primary: 西班牙汽车制造商卡特尔反垄断损害赔偿的因果证据
title_secondary: Causal evidence of antitrust damages in the car manufacturers’ cartel in Spain
authors: Juan Luis Jiménez, Carmen García-Galindo, José Manuel Ordóñez-de-Haro
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper estimates the causal impact on vehicle prices of an automobile manufacturers’ cartel that operated in Spain from 2006 to 2013. To do so, we construct a novel dataset containing manufacturers’ recommended retail prices for Spain and several unaffected European Union countries over the period 2000–2011. Exploiting variation in the timing of cartel entry across brands, we apply a difference-in-differences approach controlling for sales volume, scrappage schemes, and fixed effects. Our estimates show that the cartel increased prices in Spain by approximately 9.3% on average during the infringement period. Robustness checks confirm the consistency of the findings: the parallel trends assumption holds, results remain stable with alternative control groups, and placebo tests yield no significant effects. These findings contribute to the limited empirical literature on causal estimation of cartel overcharges and provide policy-relevant insights on the transmission of upstream collusion to final consumer prices.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了2006年至2013年间在西班牙运营的一个汽车制造商卡特尔对车辆价格的因果影响。为此，我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，包含2000年至2011年间西班牙及多个未受影响的欧盟国家的制造商建议零售价。利用各品牌加入卡特尔的时间差异，我们采用双重差分法，并控制销量、报废补贴计划及固定效应。估计结果显示，在侵权期间，该卡特尔使西班牙的汽车价格平均上涨约9.3%。稳健性检验证实了研究结果的一致性：平行趋势假设成立，使用替代对照组时结果保持稳定，安慰剂检验未产生显著效应。这些发现为关于卡特尔超额收费因果估计的有限实证文献做出了贡献，并为上游合谋向最终消费者价格传导提供了政策相关的见解。

title: Consumer‐Minded Informational Intermediary and Welfare Losses
title_zh: 消费者导向的信息中介与福利损失
title_primary: 消费者导向的信息中介与福利损失
title_secondary: Consumer‐Minded Informational Intermediary and Welfare Losses
authors: Wenji Xu, Kai Hao Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-03-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article examines the welfare implications of third-party informational intermediation. A seller sets the price of a product that is sold through an intermediary, who discloses information about the product to consumers. In a model where the intermediary is consumer-minded—has a payoff that depends on both the seller's revenue and the consumer surplus, we show that total welfare may decrease in the Pareto sense, as the intermediary's consumer-mindedness increases. Furthermore, we show that consumer-mindedness emerges endogenously when a revenue-maximizing intermediary is forward-looking and the consumer base is increasing in past consumer surplus.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了第三方信息中介的福利影响。卖方设定通过中介销售的产品价格，中介向消费者披露产品信息。在模型中，中介以消费者为导向——其收益同时取决于卖方收入和消费者剩余，我们证明，随着中介消费者导向程度的提高，总福利可能在帕累托意义上下降。此外，我们表明，当追求收入最大化的中介具有前瞻性，且消费者基数随过去消费者剩余增加时，消费者导向会内生地出现。

title: Monetary–Fiscal Policy Interactions When Price Stability Occasionally Takes a Back Seat
title_zh: 价格稳定偶尔退居次要地位时的货币-财政政策互动
title_primary: 价格稳定偶尔退居次要地位时的货币-财政政策互动
title_secondary: Monetary–Fiscal Policy Interactions When Price Stability Occasionally Takes a Back Seat
authors: Sebastian Schmidt
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-12-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract What are the macro‐economic consequences of a government that is limited in its willingness or ability to raise primary surpluses, and a central bank that accommodates its interest‐rate policy to the fiscal conditions? I address this question in a dynamic stochastic sticky‐price model with endogenous shifts between an “orthodox” and a “fiscally‐dominant” policy regime. The risk of future regime shifts has encompassing effects on equilibrium. Inflation is systematically higher than it would be if fiscal policy always adjusted its primary surplus sufficiently and monetary policy was solely concerned with price stability. This inflation bias is increasing in the real value of government debt. Regime‐switching probabilities are not invariant to policy. The central bank can attenuate the risk of a shift to the fiscally‐dominant regime by raising the real interest rate sufficiently moderately when inflation increases. Lower fiscal dominance risk, in turn, mitigates the inflation bias.
abstract_zh: 摘要 当政府受限于其提高基本财政盈余的意愿或能力，而中央银行又使其利率政策适应财政状况时，会产生怎样的宏观经济后果？我在一个动态随机粘性价格模型中探讨了这一问题，该模型包含“正统”与“财政主导”政策体制之间的内生转换。未来体制转换的风险对均衡具有广泛影响。通货膨胀系统性高于若财政政策始终充分调整其基本盈余且货币政策仅关注价格稳定时的水平。这种通胀偏差随政府债务实际价值的增加而增大。体制转换概率并非政策不变。中央银行可以通过在通胀上升时适度提高实际利率来减弱向财政主导体制转换的风险。较低的财政主导风险反过来又会缓解通胀偏差。

title: Escaping Product Market Rivalry Through Innovation
title_zh: 通过创新摆脱产品市场竞争
title_primary: 通过创新摆脱产品市场竞争
title_secondary: Escaping Product Market Rivalry Through Innovation
authors: Dandan Xia, Bruno Cassiman, David Wehrheim
official: 官方在线 2025-12-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study leverages advanced text-analysis techniques to investigate how increased product market rivalry, induced by Chinese import competition, affects innovation among incumbent U.S. firms in the electronic and electrical appliance industry. We measure the similarity between the product descriptions of U.S. firms and those of Chinese importers, thus capturing firm-level competitive pressure. Employing a continuous difference-in-differences framework, we compare innovation outcomes of U.S. firms more directly competing with Chinese importers to those facing lower competitive pressure over a five-year period before and after initial Chinese market entry. We find that incumbent U.S. firms significantly increase their quality-weighted patent production, create more new-product patents, and strategically diversify into new technological and business segments when confronted with heightened competition. Our findings highlight the role of import-driven rivalry in stimulating strategic innovation and illustrate how text-based similarity measures can effectively quantify firm-level competition, providing novel methodological tools for strategy scholars. This paper was accepted by Maria Guadalupe, business strategy. Funding: B. Cassiman acknowledges financial support from the Fonds Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek [Grants G010324N and G071417N]. D. Wehrheim acknowledges financial support from Grant Ref. PID2024-155952NB-I00, funded by MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033 and by ESF+, ERDF “A way of making Europe”, European Union. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08304 .
abstract_zh: 本研究运用先进的文本分析技术，考察由中国进口竞争所引致的市场竞争加剧如何影响美国电子与电气设备行业在位企业的创新行为。我们测度美国企业与中国进口商产品描述之间的相似度，从而捕捉企业层面的竞争压力。采用连续型双重差分框架，我们在中国首次进入市场前后的五年期间，比较与中国进口商竞争更为直接的美国企业与面临较低竞争压力的企业之间的创新结果。我们发现，当面临竞争加剧时，美国在位企业显著增加了其质量加权专利产出，创造了更多新产品专利，并战略性地向新的技术与业务领域进行多元化拓展。我们的发现凸显了进口驱动的竞争在激发战略性创新方面的作用，并说明了基于文本的相似度测度如何能够有效量化企业层面的竞争，为战略学者提供了新颖的方法论工具。本文由Maria Guadalupe（商业战略领域）接受。资助：B. Cassiman感谢Fonds Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek的资助[Grants G010324N and G071417N]。D. Wehrheim感谢Grant Ref. PID2024-155952NB-I00的资助，该资助由MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033以及ESF+、ERDF“A way of making Europe”、欧盟提供。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08304获取。

title: Stochastic volatility in mean: Efficient analysis by a generalized mixture sampler
title_zh: 均值随机波动率：基于广义混合抽样器的高效分析
title_primary: 均值随机波动率：基于广义混合抽样器的高效分析
title_secondary: Stochastic volatility in mean: Efficient analysis by a generalized mixture sampler
authors: Daichi Hiraki, Siddhartha Chib, Yasuhiro Omori
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-01-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In this paper we consider the simulation-based Bayesian analysis of stochastic volatility in mean (SVM) models. Extending the highly efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo mixture sampler for the SV model proposed in Kim et al. (1998) and Omori et al. (2007), we develop an accurate approximation of the logarithm of the non-central chi-squared distribution as a mixture of thirty normal distributions . Under this mixture representation, we sample the parameters and latent volatilities in one block. We also detail a correction of the small approximation error by using additional Metropolis–Hastings steps. The proposed method is extended to the SVM model with leverage. The methodology and models are applied to excess holding yields and S&P500 returns in empirical studies, and the SVM models are shown to outperform other volatility models based on marginal likelihoods.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了基于模拟的贝叶斯分析在随机波动率均值（SVM）模型中的应用。通过扩展Kim等人（1998）及Omori等人（2007）提出的针对SV模型的高效马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛混合抽样方法，我们开发了一种精确近似非中心卡方分布对数的方法，将其表示为三十个正态分布的混合形式。在此混合表示下，我们实现了参数与潜在波动率的联合分块抽样。同时，我们详细阐述了通过附加Metropolis-Hastings步骤来修正微小近似误差的方法，并将所提方法扩展至包含杠杆效应的SVM模型。在实证研究中，我们将该方法与模型应用于超额持有收益率及标普500指数收益率，结果表明基于边际似然比较，SVM模型优于其他波动率模型。
